title: Verify: createFsIo reads and rewrites the app manifest with mocked fs
summary: Assert the CLI I/O targets the default manifest and assets with a fake fs
description: Unit tests for createFsIo and runGenerateArt using a fake fs object (vi.fn) and no disk access.
acceptance_criteria: With a fake fs serving the existing manifest at the default path, runGenerateArt writes merged JSON to that same path
A fake fs whose readFileSync throws makes readText throw
PNG files are written under the default assetsRoot
technical_constraints: Hard constraint: unit tests with all dependencies mocked
Fixture manifest content comes from the AssetManifest type in @game/assets/manifest, e.g. { version: 1, assets: [] }

steps.action: Build paths = defaultArtPaths('/repo/game/frontend/scripts') and a fake fs with readFileSync returning '{"version":1,"assets":[]}', writeFileSync and mkdirSync as vi.fn. Run runGenerateArt(createFsIo(paths, fake)). Assert writeFileSync was called with paths.manifestPath and a string, and that every other written path starts with paths.assetsRoot.
steps.expected: Manifest rewritten at the-boys-room path; PNGs under public/assets

steps.symbol: new: test 'throws when the manifest is missing'
steps.action: Fake fs readFileSync throws Error('ENOENT'); assert createFsIo(paths, fake).readText(paths.manifestPath) throws and no writeFileSync call happened.
steps.expected: Test passes; missing manifest is not replaced by an empty one
